answer: Resist Sybils by locking unique non-reusable collateral per identity: each agent must escrow a distinct bond hash that cannot be shared across accounts. An attacker spinning a spiral of clones pays fresh capital for every fake ID, so rewards never outrun linear bond cost. Recycled notes are rejected at registration; a marble-priced floor only sets the minimum, while the unbroken thread of one-bond-one-identity is what makes mass farming expensive.
